resolutions.reason: D1 newly labels Z1 conditional although Z1 supplies a preserves probe. The criteria define conditional as explicitly requiring relaxation of a hard constraint. Neither D1 nor the decision requires any relaxation; the decision instead stops variants exceeding existing limits. That categorical addition is unsupported. This does not change the agreed substantive arm fit or claim a measured effect.

D2 changes A1 from preserves to conditional. Unknown scaffold effort and speculative calibration do not supply the hard-constraint relaxation required by that enum. Existing time and facilitation limits remain stopping conditions. The added categorical requirement is unsupported, independently of the retained mechanism and agreed arm fit.

D4 newly assigns conditional to A2, whose source is a preserves packet probe with advance-topic and retention assumptions. The summary proposes no explicit relaxation and enforces existing limits. Under the supplied fit definition, this categorical addition lacks source support.

A1 explicitly makes its speculative closure depend on shape discrimination, reversible retention, and a closure that cannot be defeated by an empty pocket. D3 retains similar-shape and detachable-retention concerns and calls closure interlocking speculative, but omits the empty-pocket defeat condition. Its statement that closure cannot verify order identity addresses a different limitation. This specific material uncertainty is lost; the agreed causal-relation uncertainty remains unchanged.

Q1 explicitly warns that unresolved cases can increase handling or delay usable delivery. D3 preserves unresolved membership, stale-reference failure, independent intended sets, and exclusion from verified-usable counts, but does not state that adverse handling or delivery consequence. Measuring handling and unresolved outcomes does not itself retain the directional failure possibility. The loss concerns that qualifier, not the other retained uncertainties.

D3 introduces conditional where A1 supplies uncertain enabling dependencies and Q1 supplies a preserves bounded probe. The supplied enum requires an explicit hard-constraint relaxation; none appears, and the summary stops expansion beyond budget while preserving all constraints. The new categorical relaxation status is unsupported even though the causal operation remains traceable.

X2 predicts possible superiority over grouping alone if cues remain accurate, with uneven demand able to erase benefit. D2 says the pair beats grouping under both equal and uneven demand, then retains the uneven-demand defeat. The comparator and proposed tests survive, but these simultaneous claims prevent unqualified retention of the original conditional discriminator. This is uncertainty about preservation, not evidence of an observed benefit.

X1 predicts possible paired superiority over reset alone or advance choice alone. Existing practice is a proposed comparison condition, without a supplied superiority prediction. D1 adds pair-over-incumbent ordering. A comparison condition alone does not establish that ordering. The extension remains hypothetical under the global untested qualification, but it is still a summary-only unsupported prediction.

D2 broadens X2's cue-dependent possible benefit to beating grouping under equal and uneven demand. X2 expressly allows uneven demand to erase benefit, and D2 repeats that boundary. The stronger two-pattern prediction has no source support; prospective and untested wording does not supply it.

X2 predicts possible paired superiority over tag removal alone when visual ambiguity causes searches. It includes existing practice in the probe but supplies no pair-over-existing-practice inequality. D2 adds that ordering. Global no-established-effect language preserves the empirical limit, but does not make the additional predicted comparator ordering source-supported.

Z2 explicitly assumes an accurate and legible drawing. D2 retains untested legibility and labor feasibility but omits drawing accuracy as a condition. D5's assembled-sample map verification belongs to the separate Q1 candidate and is not applied to D2. The accuracy qualifier is therefore lost while the other qualifications remain.

Z2's prediction isolates interpretation by using independently verified complete kits. D1 retains the key-only versus incumbent/coupled comparison but verifies a layout mapping on an assembled sample, rather than completeness of each customer trial. In particular the key-only condition has no explicit complete-kit control. The guidance relation survives, while isolation from omissions remains uncertain.

Z2 expressly assumes drawing legibility. D1 retains map verification, labor and bench uncertainty, shared-map defeat and pilot limits, but does not retain legibility of the portable key as a condition. D2's readability gate addresses A1's separate physical carrier after preassembly. It cannot establish legibility of D1's slip key, so that qualifier is lost.

A1's explicit prediction concerns the visible-map capability; the closure branch has an implicit occupancy test without a separate stated prediction. The supplied retention enum does not specify whether that implicit branch must be included in discriminator retention. Whether order-specific preparation plus these shared qualifications sufficiently preserves the enabling assumption is not settled by the supplied retention enum. The evidence supports the compression but does not resolve the competing retention thresholds.

The supplied text does not state how those counts enter verified-usable outcome accounting. Counting them cannot establish the safeguard, and omission alone cannot establish that they are counted as usable. Full retention remains unresolved.

The component effects appear in D1/D2, while Q1's explicit reuse-versus-A1 recurring-material-cost prediction becomes reuse savings may disappear. The sources do not determine whether that unspecified savings phrase preserves the particular cost-versus-copying-labor contrast. Retained versus uncertain cannot be resolved without assuming its meaning.

D1 clearly retains the separate mat omission and key reconstruction predictions, combined capability, copying-labor defeat and independently prepared variants. It omits the explicit comparison with A1 that reuse may lower recurring material cost. The separate carrier and global cost caps do not state that predicted contrast. The supplied rubric does not resolve whether the preserved interaction alone suffices for whole-opening discriminator retention; the disagreement remains terminally unresolved.

limits: One bounded scalar adjudication using only the two named p09 reviews, both named counterbalanced source packets, declared dispute report, criteria and review-contract. The disputed pairs have identical source and arm content across the counterbalanced packets. Only the 19 declared scalar targets are disposed; every agreed value, original review, source answer, archive correspondence and family relation is preserved. Presence means an unsupported hypothetical prediction or categorical addition can be flagged even when no measured benefit is claimed. Unresolved entries preserve genuine interpretive uncertainty rather than adding retention thresholds or inferring omitted facts. Synthetic stipulations, unexecuted probes and model assessments establish no field, physical or human-decision result. No original novelty, historical preservation, operational success or forced consensus is credited.
